Evidence:
[1] Robin of Sherwood (retitled Robin Hood in the United States) is a British television series, based on the legend of Robin Hood.
[2] He wrote, produced, and/or directed many classic animated cartoon shorts starring Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner, Pepé Le Pew, Porky Pig, Michigan J. Frog, the Three Bears, and a slew of other Warner characters.
[3] It was also the second parody of Robin Hood directed by Chuck Jones, after the 1949 Bugs Bunny short "Rabbit Hood".
[4] Robin Hood Makes Good is a 1938 Merrie Melodies color cartoon short, directed by Chuck Jones and written by Dave Monahan, and released by Warner Bros. on February 11, 1939.
